website.readmeExcerpt:
# Fr4nsson's FFXIV Dalamud Plugins ## About Here you can find all my FFXIV Dalamud plugins. ## How to Install 1. Download and install [XIVLauncher](https://goatcorp.github.io/) 2. Copy line below ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Fr4nsson/MyDalamudPlugins/main/pluginmaster.json ``` 3. Go to Dalamud Settings -> Experimental -> Custom Plugin Repositories 4. Paste it on an empty line and click the + on the far right to add it 5. Click Save and Close 6. You can now find the plugins under Available Plugins ## Plugins | Name | Description | |---------------|-----------------| | [Hide Padlock](https://github.com/Fr4nsson/MyDalamudPlugins/tree/main/src/HidePadlock) | Allows you to toggle the visibility of the padlock that is next to hotbar one.

Use /padlock to toggle visibility.
Use //padlock to open settings. |
